table.mass_meaning: a binding's mass is a sum over the heads and layers that read it (count reads; mean_mass per read)
table.attribution: a read (row, layer, head, source) belongs to the binding holding its value cell v

legend.#: read with mass at or above min_mass
legend.-: no value cell of this binding at that layer

unbound.meaning: attention mass of the bindings not on this page, per head summed; the consumer part no listed binding's reads carry, by part

bound.reason: the rounding bound's accumulation premise fails on this run (see `explain`)

parts.meaning: embedding, MLP and head-bias terms; the layers' attention output (native o, read exactly) minus the listed reads (reads of bindings off this page, heads an edit wrote, o_proj rounding); residual-stream edits; the measured remainder (residual-add, final-norm and head rounding) with its bound

partition.meaning: per head, the sum over all bindings of their mass minus sum_s p (float64 summation order only)

accounting.meaning: per head, bindings + Unbound = sum_s p (native); |sum_s p - 1| against T u_dtype + 2 T u_f32 (softmax in float32, each weight cast to the dtype)
